Wikimip.com Affiliate Marketing Plan
1. Brand Introduction
Wikimip.com is a Colorado-based bullet journaling supply brand dedicated to providing high-quality and unique products for journal enthusiasts worldwide. We offer a wide range of products, including journals, writing tools, decorative accessories, and storage solutions, aimed at helping users personalize their journaling experience. Our mission is to make bullet journaling simple, fun, and environmentally friendly by combining creativity with functionality.

2. Product Description
Wikimip.com offers the following key products:

Journals and Notebooks: Available in various sizes, cover designs, and paper types (such as dot grid, blank, and lined), specifically designed for journal and diary enthusiasts.
Writing Tools: Fine liners, brush pens, and high-quality markers, ensuring a smooth and precise writing and creative experience.
Decorative Accessories: A variety of stickers, washi tapes, stamps, and stencils to help users personalize their journal pages.
Storage and Organizational Tools: Including pen cases, journal covers, and desk organizers for convenient storage and protection of stationery supplies.
Eco-Friendly Line: Products made with sustainable and environmentally-friendly materials, promoting a green lifestyle.
3. Unique Selling Point (USP)
Diverse and High-Quality Products: We carefully select premium materials to ensure every product is durable and aesthetically pleasing, offering a wide variety of choices to meet customers' individual needs.
Exclusive Designs: We collaborate with designers to launch limited-edition and exclusive products, enhancing the collectible value for customers.
Sustainability Commitment: We are dedicated to promoting sustainability by offering eco-friendly product lines and reducing plastic packaging, contributing to environmental protection.
Excellent Customer Service: We provide comprehensive customer support and journaling tutorials, ensuring continuous assistance and inspiration for customers after their purchase.
4. Payment Terms
Affiliate Commission Structure: Affiliates earn a 10-15% commission on every sale generated through their exclusive referral link, with specific rates depending on monthly sales performance.
Payout Schedule: Commissions are settled monthly, with a minimum payout threshold of $50. Once the threshold is reached, payments will be made via PayPal or bank transfer.
Cookie Duration: We offer a 60-day cookie duration to ensure that affiliates receive credit for sales from referred customers, even if the purchase is not immediate.
Instant Support: Affiliates can access dedicated support channels for quick assistance to ensure their promotional activities run smoothly.
5. Other Information
Affiliate Requirements: We welcome journal enthusiasts, stationery bloggers, lifestyle content creators, and influencers to join us.  with consistent traffic.
Marketing Support: Once enrolled, affiliates receive exclusive marketing resources, including high-quality product images, promotional banners, discount codes, and customized campaign strategies.
Exclusive Discounts: Affiliates can offer exclusive discount codes to their followers, encouraging more engagement and sales.
Real-Time Performance Tracking: Through our affiliate management platform, affiliates can track clicks, sales, and commissions in real-time, ensuring transparency and efficiency in the partnership.
How to Join: Interested partners can apply through our affiliate program page at [Affiliate Program URL] or contact us directly at [email address] for more information.
